subject: Nebula Health — PO trigger and temporary exception request
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nebulahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Nebula’s integration lead and I walked away excited about the latency numbers. We’re preparing the intake for a two-month technical pilot (non-prod) and procurement asked whether Redwood will accept invoices for this pilot without a PO in place. Our procurement team has limited ability to issue POs for short-term pilots under $5k, and they asked for a documented exception path.

Attached is our standard PO waiver request form and a draft MSA (nebula_msa_draft.docx). Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can invoice Net 30 without a PO for the pilot amount (approx. $2,800/mo)
- What evidence Redwood needs on our side (insurance, SOC2, PO waiver form, PO number later)

If not possible, what alternative would you recommend so we can move quickly?

Appreciate it — Olivia
Director, Procurement
Nebula Health

[Attachment: nebula_po_request.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Hi Olivia — great to hear. Forwarding to procurement for confirmation but high-level we can often support a controlled invoice-only approach for short pilots with a few guardrails. Markus, Jordan — looping you in so we can confirm limits and evidence.

Olivia, initial suggestion from Sales:
- Pilot treated as month-to-month subscription, Redwood invoices Net 30
- No PO required while pilot is below $3k/month or total committed spend remains under $6k
- Nebula provides: completed PO waiver form (received), current COI (insurance), and point of contact for later PO issuance if pilot converts
- Redwood to add a short addendum noting the temporary exception and automatic PO re-evaluation at conversion

If procurement needs higher assurance (prepay or credit card on file) we can discuss, but the above has worked for other pilots. Markus / Jordan — what internal approvals do we need to make this an approved deviation?

Thanks,
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: nebula_msa_draft.docx referenced]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Rachel / Jordan — reviewing. Procurement policy generally requires a PO for any active supplier, but we maintain a documented exception process for pilots under low dollar thresholds. Conditions I need to approve a no-PO exception:
1) Completed vendor intake (we have the waiver PDF from Olivia, good)
2) Evidence of insurance (COI) and primary contact
3) Spending guardrails: cap at $3k/month OR $6k total for the exception window
4) A sign-off from Finance for Net 30 terms against current credit risk profile

Jordan — can Finance do a provisional approval for D-NEB-739 under these caps if legal signs the short addendum? If so I’ll approve and Rachel can confirm to Nebula. If not, we should offer a short prepay month or credit-card option to avoid a delay.

Markus
Head of Procurement
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: procurement_evidence.xlsx (stub) — vendor intake checklist]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Markus — Finance can provisionally approve a Net 30 invoice-only path for pilots that meet the procurement conditions. A few operational notes:
- We’ll need Nebula to complete a 1-page credit risk attestation (I can share a template)
- Set an automatic alert at $2,800 invoiced or 80% of agreed cap so we don’t unintentionally exceed the threshold
- Flag the account in billing as "pilot-no-po-exception: D-NEB-739" to ensure collections and cash forecasting reflect the deviation

If legal can give a short addendum acknowledging this is temporary and that a PO may be required upon conversion, we’re fine to proceed. Rachel — please confirm Nebula can provide COI + signed waiver and we’ll produce the attestation template and addendum.

Jordan Blake
Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on PO requirement for pilot

Hi Olivia — thanks for the waiver form. Quick status update and next steps so we can get you onboarded Monday:

Confirmed (provisionally):
- Redwood will invoice Net 30 without a PO for the two-month technical pilot under these conditions: COI + completed PO waiver form received; total pilot spend capped at $6,000; monthly cap of $3,000.
- Finance will add a pilot exception tag and put monitoring alerts at 80% of cap.
- Legal will prepare a one-paragraph addendum clarifying the temporary nature of the exception and that a PO may be required on conversion.

Action items for Nebula:
- Send COI (certificate of insurance) and the completed waiver form to procurement@redwoodinference.com (I have attached nebula_po_request.pdf for reference).
- Confirm billing contact and PO escalation contact (name / email) who will be responsible if you convert to production.

Attachments: nebula_po_request.pdf (you already sent), we’ll share the credit attestation template and the addendum DocuSign link after procurement confirms receipt.

If any of your procurement stakeholders require a different approach (prepay or PO in advance) let me know and we can accommodate — but this path should keep the pilot moving.

Best,
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: nebula_po_request.pdf (PDF)]
